plainTranslation: Their Mars in your 4th house: they stir up your home and roots - energy, passion, sometimes friction in your most private space. Failure mode: conflict landing where you're most vulnerable. Channel the heat into building together; keep the fights out of the home.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
